description: Thresholds for the Xerberus liquidity-exit gate

max_days_to_exit.description: Maximum tolerated days to unwind the proposed position within the modeled impact band. The design reference uses 7.

max_impact_band_pct.description: Maximum impact band (percent) the quote may be modeled at. Guards against a caller requesting a looser band than the curator accepts. The design reference uses 1 (0.5 for stablecoins).

deny_on_stale.description: When true, deny whenever Xerberus flags its data window as stale (is_stale). Keep true for exposure-increasing actions.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Xerberus data window, measured at evaluation time.

require_token_in_intent.description: When true, deny unless the quoted token address is the intent's call target or appears in its decoded arguments, so a quote for one token cannot authorise a transaction moving another.
